noticias.titulo: Earnings Week Ahead: ORCL, ADBE, KR, GME, CHWY, and more
noticias.resumo:
## Quick Insights

 Investors are watching if Oracle can convert its large AI-driven backlog into reported revenue and accelerate growth while addressing capital intensity concerns. 
 The focus is on Adobe's ability to maintain strong AI-driven annualized recurring revenue growth, successful AI monetization, and meet elevated expectations despite a leadership transition. 
 Investors are looking for evidence that Kroger's investments in e-commerce and productivity will lead to stronger comparable sales, improved margins, and reach its annual guidance.
